purpose: Synthetic STIX/OpenCTI-side mapping fixture for a bounded import-hash traversal slice. It uses example-only hash values and does not model live OpenCTI ingestion.

targets.name: example-stale.bin
targets.suppression_reason: The observation is outside the CTI_SAMPLE_IMPHASH_CLUSTER temporal window for the fixture as_of date.

expected_suppressed_targets.reason: The observation is outside the CTI_SAMPLE_IMPHASH_CLUSTER temporal window for the fixture as_of date.

blocked_assertions: Validated lifecycle state is not a runtime confidence score.
A shared import hash is feature evidence, not proof of common operator identity, authorship, ownership, or attribution.
The generated STIX bundle is a mapping artifact only; it does not assert maliciousness, compromise, malware-family membership, or final assessment.
Suppressed traversal candidates must not be emitted as ordinary STIX relationship objects.
OpenCTI ingestion, synchronization, marking, scoring, and workflow state are outside this fixture.

extension_creator.description: EveryPivot Project is the creator of this extension. This project-level Identity conveys extension provenance only, not source reliability, analyst or reviewer authority, or accepted assessment status.
